what.text: This page follows internal displacement in Tajikistan, as recorded by UNHCR and IDMC, shown side by side and never added together.
UNHCR's data gives 25285 internally displaced people in Tajikistan for 1996.
IDMC records 15000 new displacements from conflict and violence in 2021, a count of movements, not people.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Tajikistan in 2010 and 2011, with the Forces of Mullo Abdullo and the IMU.
It also records an interstate armed conflict between Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan in 2021 and 2022, and earthquakes are the disasters recorded for Tajikistan in IDMC's data.

when.text: IDMC's figures for Tajikistan cover 2010 to 2025, and its 2021 count of new displacements falls in the years of the conflict with Kyrgyzstan.
The fact pack names no main years of displacement for this page.

how.text: The sources don't say where displaced people are living or which routes they took.
IDMC's new displacements count movements, not people, so someone forced to move twice is counted twice.
